title: Keyboard Typing
blurb: The sound of somebody absolutely cooking at a computer, whether or not anything is being accomplished. Cinema decided decades ago that this means hacking; offices decided it means productivity; shared documents have established that it means passive aggression. All three readings remain available. Layer it under a screen recording for instant competence, or play it while staring blankly at a wall to reassure nearby colleagues that output is occurring. Mechanical keyboards exist substantially because this noise is enjoyable. Clack clack clack.
origin: Fast mechanical keyboard typing — cinema's universal 'hacking' sound.
